clauses: Count every matched telescope in each phase, including those with missing bandwidth usage.
Count only telescopes with a non-missing bandwidth usage value in each phase.
readings: Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), find the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), ignoring missing values, and how many are in that phase. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Give one row with three values: the average of those phases' bandwidth averages, the total count across them, and the average amount by which they exceed the mean. Don't round. Count every matched telescope in each phase, including those with missing bandwidth usage.

Match each telescope to its observatory on `observstation`, and drop unmatched telescopes. For each moon phase (`observatories.lunarstage`; a missing phase is its own group), find the average bandwidth usage (`telescopes.bandusagepct`), ignoring missing values, and how many are in that phase. Keep the phases whose average is above the mean of all the phase averages. Give one row with three values: the average of those phases' bandwidth averages, the total count across them, and the average amount by which they exceed the mean. Don't round. Count only telescopes with a non-missing bandwidth usage value in each phase.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS stage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g
),
k AS (
  SELECT g.avg_bw, g.cnt, m.mean_avg
  FROM g, m
  WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs,
       SUM(cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(avg_bw - mean_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM k;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS stage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
  HAVING COUNT(t.bandusagepct) > 0
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs,
       SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(g.avg_bw - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM g, m
WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg;
